name: Spec Templates
description: Spec Templates — the scaffolding a new spec repository in this estate is authored from: the honest not-yet-migrated shell pattern, the AAO charter shape, the shared hygiene files, and the test that keeps a shell's docs honest about what is and is not runnable yet. AAO expands to Agentic Autonomous Organization.

roles.name: template
roles.purpose: Publishes and maintains the scaffolding templates and the generation rules a new spec repository in this estate is authored from.
roles.measure: Shells scaffolded from this repository's own generator, as a share of new spec repositories opened

roles.name: conformance
roles.purpose: Runs the checker over the templates themselves, and over anything scaffolded from them, and reports which cases pass rather than a green tick that read nothing.
roles.measure: honesty.test.mjs cases passing, as a share of the committed suite

roles.name: release
roles.purpose: Cuts versioned releases of the template set with a changelog entry, so a version says what the templates will refuse and never moves once it ships.
roles.measure: Releases with a changelog entry, as a share of tags

roles.name: adoption
roles.purpose: Helps a new spec repository bootstrap from these templates and records how many have, because a template nobody has used is not yet worth keeping.
roles.measure: Spec repositories scaffolded from this generator, as a share of new spec repositories opened

roles.name: review
roles.purpose: Reviews a proposed change to the templates before it lands, because a change to the scaffold changes every spec repository authored from it afterward.
roles.measure: Template changes carrying an approving review, as a share of merges
